fields.description: When enabled, users only see vertical apps that match their default Company business activity (plus platform apps like Accounting).
fields.label: Filter Desk Apps by Company Activity

fields.description: Comma-separated roles that always see all installed apps on Desk (for administration).
fields.label: Activity Filter Exempt Roles

fields.description: JSON array of app slugs manually hidden from the Desk apps launcher. Managed from ErpGenEx Marketplace.
fields.label: Hidden Desk Apps (manual)
Help
fields.options: Set Business Activity on each Company. Desk shows only matching vertical apps + platform apps (Accounting, e-Invoice, etc.). Use Marketplace to manually hide/show individual apps.

fields.description: RSA/EC public key PEM used to verify JWT license keys from the storefront. Alternative: set omnexa_license_public_key_pem in site config.
fields.label: License Public Key PEM

fields.description: Optional developer / internal bypass code accepted in Marketplace → Activate Key (same as omnexa_developer_bypass_code in site config).
fields.label: Developer Bypass Code

fields.description: GitHub PAT (repo scope) for Marketplace Update from GitHub. Or set omnexa_github_token in site config.
fields.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
License Help
fields.options: Paid apps need a signed JWT from the shop, or a matching bypass code above. Plain passwords are not JWTs — configure the bypass code here if you use one.
